name: web-verify
description: Playwright and axe smoke harness. Drives BASE_URL, writes receipt-shaped JSON under out/.

scripts.selftest: VERIFY_FIXTURES=1 BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4173 ROUTES=/pass.html playwright test && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/to-receipt.ts
scripts.selftest:fail: VERIFY_FIXTURES=1 BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4173 ROUTES=/fail.html playwright test; ec=$?; node --experimental-strip-types scripts/to-receipt.ts || exit $?; exit $ec
